sources.title: Which firms does the PRA regulate? | Bank of England – the UK's central bank

brands.evidence: Monzo is a licensed UK bank, and the app is how you manage your account.

client_claims.text: Monzo is a licensed UK bank
client_claims.note: Consistent with Monzo being a UK bank authorised by the PRA.

client_claims.text: The Bank of England lists it as Monzo Bank Limited, firm reference 730427.
client_claims.note: Facts do not give the firm reference number or the Bank of England listing.

client_claims.text: FSCS would protect your eligible deposits up to £120,000 per person across your accounts with Monzo Bank Limited, not per account.
client_claims.note: Matches the £120,000 per person FSCS protection.

client_claims.text: The app is how you manage your account.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover how the account is managed.
